transcript: These three Claude plugins let you scrape anything off the internet without paying for anything. The first is ScrapeGraphAI that lets you scrape any website with a simple text prompt. You just tell it what you want, and it'll come back with clean structured data instantly. Then there's Agent Reach, which takes it a step further and lets you guys scrape even gated platforms like LinkedIn, Instagram, X, and Reddit, all with no API key required. And finally, there's Scrapling MCP, which has already crossed over 70,000 stars on GitHub. This automatically adapts whenever a site changes its layout so your scraping setup can keep working instead of breaking every few weeks like usual. So if you want to try them all yourselves, just comment plugin down below and I'll send them to you directly.
